authority_boundary_note: Browser-integrated translation remains subordinate to the current official page and the named translated/help lane the office actually stands behind.
auto_translate_persistence_note: Browser translation can vary by browser, settings, language pair, region, account state, and per-site/per-language preferences; the page keeps original-language identity and official help routing visible enough that continued translation does not become a hidden publication channel.
browser_translation_surface_label: Example browser-integrated translation posture for official voter-information routes
delivery_role_note: The service reviews official voter-information pages so browser-integrated page translation, selected-text translation, and auto-translate persistence remain subordinate to the current official page plus any reviewed official translated/help lane rather than quietly becoming a shadow official publication.
high_risk_topic_routing_note: When translation ambiguity affects deadline, eligibility, ID, cure, or rights-sensitive questions, the route moves the voter back to the current official translated/help lane instead of pretending browser translation settled the matter.
official_translation_availability_note: If the office publishes a reviewed translated page for this topic, that reviewed official translation remains the preferred authoritative multilingual lane; browser convenience translation of the original-language page is subordinate.
original_language_recovery_note: The page preserves enough source-language identity and official translated/help routing that the voter can recover the controlling original or reviewed multilingual lane without guesswork.
privacy_minimization_note: The service preserves route IDs, reviewed translation context labels, policy notes, and timestamps rather than individualized translation prompts or language histories.

selected_text_translation_boundary_note: Isolated translated excerpts are not treated as complete official answers when qualifiers, exceptions, or help routing matter.
